candidates.description: This feature vector activates strongly in response to Hindi text and Devanagari script elements.
This vector represents Hindi vowel matras combined with punctuation marks.
This vector represents Hindi characters, diacritics, and short common words.
This feature vector activates on specific Brahmi-derived Indic script vowel signs, combining diacritics, and rare character fragments.
This vector activates for various common Hindi character fragments and inflectional suffixes.
This feature vector is related to subword tokens and fragments commonly found in Hindi script and transliterated text.
This vector represents various consonant-vowel combinations and characters in the Devanagari script.
This vector represents subword tokens and fragments of Hindi text, particularly involving the roots of reading and writing.
This vector is related to Hindi vowel signs, nasalization markers, and dependent vowel diacritics.
These tokens represent fragments and characters from the Hindi writing system, specifically involving the consonant "भ" (bha) and related Devanagari script elements.
